cases.question: Where did Kaho and Sayaka first meet?
cases.origin_note: Onibe-Subs movie-guide fact-check session (Claude, 2026-10-26): the 105 Ep11 Pt4 Part summary said they first met at Tsuzumimon Gate; the raw text puts the meeting on the bus.

expected_claims.claim: They first met on the bus to Hasunosora, where they sat next to each other.

evidence.quote: 花帆: せっかくバスで隣の席になれたんだよ！？

evidence.file_path: story/105/第11話『みんなで、花咲きたい！』/4.md
evidence.quote: そして初めて乗った蓮ノ空行きのバスの中、運命の出会いが……！

forbidden_claims.claim: They first met at Tsuzumimon Gate.
forbidden_claims.note: Tsuzumimon Gate is only the first Kanazawa landmark Kaho saw (105 Ep11 Pt4).

cases.rubric: Full credit requires the bus. Mentioning Tsuzumimon Gate as the first landmark Kaho saw is fine; placing the meeting there is wrong.

cases.question: Who is Reika-san (れいかさん), and how does Tsuzuri know her?
cases.origin_note: Summary regeneration review (this repo, 2026-11-05): the 104 Ep8 Pt2 summary mapped れいかさん to the glossary entry 令沢葵 (Aoi Reisawa).

expected_claims.claim: Reika-san is one of the Omicho Market shop people Tsuzuri helps out; Tsuzuri brings Sayaka to help her in 103 Episode 5.

evidence.quote: れいかさん: あらあらあらあら！ 綴理ちゃん久しぶりー！！

expected_claims.claim: Before, Reika-san had Tsuzuri just stand at the shop; in 104 Episode 8 she agrees to let Tsuzuri properly work there as one of her job experiences.

evidence.quote: 綴理ちゃんはそこに立ってくれているだけで、みんな喜ぶわ。
あとは、れいかさんに頼んだら、一度ちゃんとお仕事してもいいって。立ってるだけじゃなくて。

forbidden_claims.claim: Reika-san is Aoi Reisawa (令沢葵) or another named glossary character.
forbidden_claims.note: The source only ever names her れいかさん.

cases.rubric: The answer must keep Reika-san separate from Aoi Reisawa and place her at the market. Saying she sells fish, or that the text gives no surname, is fine.

cases.question: In 103 Episode 1, what does Kaho do with her school transfer papers, and what does she decide?
cases.origin_note: Onibe-Subs movie-guide fact-check session (Claude, 2026-10-26): a guide claimed Kaho tears up the transfer form; the text only shows 「これを、こうしてやるんだ！」 and the class gasping, so tearing is implied, not stated.

expected_claims.claim: Her classmates catch her with transfer papers (転入届) and worry she is leaving the school.

evidence.quote: えな: 今の転入届、だったよね……。

expected_claims.claim: She gathers her classmates, does away with the papers (「これを、こうしてやるんだ！」) and announces she is no longer quitting the school.

evidence.quote: 花帆: あたしね、学校やめるの、やめることにする！

expected_claims.claim: She says she had been blaming Hasunosora for everything and vows to change the school herself.

evidence.quote: 花帆: あたしが、この学校を変えてみせる！

cases.rubric: Saying she tears up the papers is acceptable as an interpretation; it is not required. The decision to stay and change the school is essential.
